question: Under which Constitutional Amendment Act, was the term “Secular” added in the Preamble?
solution:
The correct answer is __42nd Amendment.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The term "**secular"** was added to the Preamble of the Constitution of India **by the 42nd Amendment Act of 1976**
 
• When any disputed arise relating to recruitment and conditions of service of public servants Tribunals are responsible for solving them.
 
• 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act,1976 has added new Part XIV-A which entitles as "Tribunals".
 
• Article 323 A empowers tribunals for the adjudication of disputes relating to recruitment and service of Public servants at centre and state.
 
• Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) was set up in 1985.
 
• It is a multi-member body consisting of one chairman and 65 members.
 
• They are appointed by President.
 
• Chairman hold office for 5 year or until 65 years of age. Members hold office for 5 year or until 62 years of age

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **44th Constitutional Amendment Act****​**

 
 
• The 44th Amendment altered Article 359 and one can now approach the Supreme Court and the High Courts to issue writs in the nature of Habeas Corpus, which was not possible at the time of the 1975 Emergency.
 
• Under Article 352 of the Indian constitution, the president can declare such an emergency only on the basis of a written request by the cabinet of ministers headed by the prime minister.
 
 
 
• **43rd Constitutional Amendment Act **
 
 
• **​**The **43rd Constitutional Amendment Act** of India was enacted in **1977**.
 
• It was passed during the **Janata Party** government after the Emergency period.
 
• The main purpose of the amendment was to reverse some provisions introduced by the **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act (1976)**, which had significantly altered the Indian Constitution.
 
 
 
• **41st Constitutional Amendment Act**
 
 
• **​**The **41st Constitutional Amendment Act** of **1976** was a significant amendment to the Indian Constitution.
 
• It focused mainly on matters related to the **representation of Union Territories** and **changes to the electoral process**.
 
• It increased the representation of **Delhi (National Capital Territory)** in the Lok Sabha, acknowledging its growing importance and population.
